description: Reference to DSC-PERF-003 - same underlying issue
approach: This issue is a duplicate of DSC-PERF-003. Both issues describe the same problem: React hook useEconomicData returns Map which prevents React's shallow comparison from working correctly, causing unnecessary re-renders. See DSC-PERF-003 solution for the fix.

tasks.title: Apply DSC-PERF-003 solution
tasks.description: This issue is resolved by implementing the solution for DSC-PERF-003. The fix converts Map to Record (plain object) which React can shallow compare correctly.
implementation: Verify that shallow comparison works after Map-to-Record conversion

criteria: React shallow comparison works for seriesMap
